post.description:
Cancels recalibration on this device

Only MSS admin users can cancel recalibration

Args:
    bcc_client: the BCC client for the given backend
    ignore_errors: whether to ignore errors during recalibration
    requester: the admin user requesting this operation

    general information on the status of the request

Only MSS admin users can get recalibration info

    requester: the admin user requesting this operation

    the information about the recalibration

Initializes recalibration of the given backend

Only MSS admin users can initialize recalibration

    bcc_client: the BCC client for the given backend

    interval: the recalibration interval; default = None i.e. no repeat

Args:

Returns:
    general information on the status of the request

get.description:

get.description:
Gets user email addresses, for completing the admin project forms

Superuser only, and deliberately so: a superuser already sees every member address
through ProjectAdminView, whereas a directory of addresses handed to any logged-in
user would be a disclosure. Returns addresses alone, never the user records.

Args:
    database: the database where the users are stored
    requester: the superuser making the request; anyone else gets a 403
    search: a case-insensitive substring of the address; omit for the first page
    limit: the maximum number of addresses to return

Returns:
    the matched email addresses, alphabetically

get.description:
Views all available bookings of the given backend

    database: the database where the users are kept, to name them
    requester: the current signed-in user
    skip: number of records to ignore at the top of the returned results; default is 0
    limit: maximum number of records to return; default is None.
    sort: fields to sort by; prepending a "-" returns the items in descending order of that field

    max_start_utc: the latest end timestamp to include in the returned results; default is None

    the paginated list of the available bookings filtered accordingly

    UnknownBccError: Unknown backend '{backend}'

Raises:
    401: not logged in
    403: the user has no app token of that id

put.description:
Moves the expiry of the current user's unexpired app token of the given id

Args:
    database: the database where the app tokens are stored
    _id: the id of the app token
    payload: the new expiry
    user_id: the id of the current logged-in user

Returns:
    the updated app token

Raises:
    401: not logged in
    404: the user has no unexpired app token of that id

get.description:
Gets the current user's app token of the given id; the token string is not shown

Args:
    database: the database where the app tokens are stored
    id: the id of the app token
    user_id: the id of the current logged-in user

Returns:
    the app token

Raises:
    401: not logged in
    404: the user has no app token of that id
